transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um, yeah… thanks for seeing me. I guess the main thing is my eating’s been kind of off lately. I mean, I’m still getting through work and everything, but some days before a shift I’ll realize I’ve only had coffee and maybe a granola bar.

And, uh… my scrubs are fitting looser than they used to, which I’m not trying to do or anything. I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but it seemed like maybe I should get it checked out.
Have you noticed a change in your appetite lately, or have you been intentionally eating less than usual?

Yeah… I mean, I’m not trying to eat less on purpose or lose weight or anything. It’s just been… kind of slipping, I guess. Some days before work I’ll realize I’ve only had coffee and maybe a granola bar, and then I just keep going.

And my scrubs have been hanging a little looser, so… I figured maybe I shouldn’t ignore it. I don’t know if that counts as a big appetite change, but it’s definitely not intentional.
Have you noticed any significant weight loss recently, even if you weren’t trying to lose weight?

Yeah, I think so… I haven’t been weighing myself a lot, so I don’t want to overstate it, but my scrubs are definitely hanging looser than they used to. And I’m not trying to lose weight or anything.

It’s more like my eating just kind of falls away on work days—coffee, maybe a granola bar, and then I realize later that’s pretty much all I had before a shift. I don’t know if that counts as “significant,” but it’s enough that I noticed.
Can you estimate how much weight you think you’ve lost recently, even if it’s just a guess based on how your clothes fit?

Um… I’m not totally sure, honestly. I haven’t really been tracking it on a scale. If I had to guess just from how my scrubs fit, maybe a few pounds? Enough that they feel looser, but I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is.

It’s just that my eating’s been kind of slipping—like coffee and a granola bar before a shift some days—and I’m not trying to lose weight. Does that answer what you mean?
Have you lost more than 5% of your body weight without trying recently?

I don’t know that I can honestly say it’s more than 5%, because I haven’t really been weighing myself. I don’t want to guess wrong.

What I can say is my eating’s been pretty off—some days it’s just coffee and maybe a granola bar before a shift—and my scrubs are hanging looser even though I’m not trying to lose weight. So… maybe, but I’m not sure if it meets that 5% mark.
Can you tell me if your unintentional weight loss has been more than 5% of your usual body weight, even if you haven’t tracked it exactly on a scale?

I’m sorry, I don’t think I can say for sure it’s over 5%. I haven’t tracked it closely enough on a scale to give you a real number.

What I can say is… my eating has gotten pretty off. Some days before a shift I barely get down coffee and a granola bar, and then my scrubs are hanging looser even though I’m not trying to lose weight. So it’s noticeable to me, but I don’t want to overstate it if that makes sense.
Have you been feeling less interested in eating or found that you don’t feel like eating during the day, even when you know you should?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to make it sound like I’m refusing to eat or anything, but my appetite’s just been kind of… not there a lot of the time.

Some days before a shift I’ll only manage coffee and a granola bar, and I know that’s not really enough. I just don’t feel like eating, or I put it off, and then my scrubs have been fitting looser even though I’m not trying to lose weight. Does that make sense?
Has your lack of interest in eating been happening most of the time, even when you're not busy with work?

Yeah… I think it’s not only work, though work makes it easier to ignore.

Even on days I’m not rushing, I just don’t really feel like eating much. I’ll tell myself I should, and then it ends up being coffee or something small, like a granola bar, and I realize later that’s basically all I had. I don’t mean to make it sound dramatic, but my scrubs have been hanging looser, so I guess it’s been happening enough to notice.
Has there been a time when you’ve gone an entire day without really feeling like eating at all, even when you weren’t busy or distracted?

I don’t know if I’d say a whole entire day with nothing at all… I don’t want to exaggerate it.

But there have been days where it’s basically like I don’t feel hungry, and I only end up with coffee and maybe a granola bar before work, and then I just kind of keep going. It’s gotten off enough that my scrubs are hanging looser, even though I’m not trying to lose weight.
Has your lack of interest in eating or reduced appetite been occurring even on days when you’re relaxed and not at work, or does it seem to only happen during busy or stressful times?

It’s not only the busy or stressful days, no. I mean, work definitely makes it easier to put it off, but even when I’m more relaxed, my eating is just… off.

Some days it’s like I’ll only really get down coffee and maybe a granola bar before a shift, and then I realize later that’s not much. I’m not trying to lose weight or anything, but my scrubs have been hanging looser, so I guess it’s happening enough to matter. Does that answer what you mean?
Has this lack of interest in eating or feeling like you don’t want to eat been going on for several months, or is it more of a recent change?

It feels more recent than “several months,” I think… I mean, it’s been long enough that I’ve noticed it and my scrubs are hanging looser, but I don’t want to overstate it.

What brought me in is that my eating has gotten pretty off—some days I’m barely getting down coffee and a granola bar before a shift, and I’m not trying to lose weight or anything. Is that the kind of timeframe you’re asking about?
Has this lack of interest in eating been going on for more than three months, or less than that?

Less than three months, I think. I don’t want to make it sound bigger than it is, but it’s been enough that I’ve noticed—some days I’m barely getting down coffee and a granola bar before a shift, and my scrubs are fitting looser even though I’m not trying to lose weight.
Has there been a day recently when you didn’t feel like eating at all, even when you weren’t stressed, distracted, or at work?

Yeah… I think there have been days like that. I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but my eating has just gotten pretty off.

Like, even if I’m not rushed or stressed, I’ll realize I barely had anything—maybe just coffee and a granola bar before a shift—and I’m not really feeling hungry the way I should. And my scrubs have been hanging looser, which I guess means it’s not just in my head. I’m not trying to lose weight or anything.
Can you recall a specific time when you genuinely felt hungry, even if you didn't end up eating much?

Um… I’m trying to think of a specific time. It’s not like I never feel hungry, exactly. Maybe before a shift I’ll notice my stomach feels empty, but then I only get down coffee and maybe a granola bar and just kind of keep going.

I know that probably doesn’t sound great. I’m not trying to lose weight or anything, but my scrubs have been hanging looser, so I guess the eating being off is showing up a little. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Can you tell me if there have been days when you genuinely didn't feel any desire to eat at all, even when you weren't busy, stressed, or distracted?

Yeah… I think so. Not every day, and I don’t want to overstate it, but there have been days where food just doesn’t appeal to me at all, even if I’m not really doing anything.

Mostly I notice it because I’ll get to a shift and realize I’ve only had coffee and maybe a granola bar, and it doesn’t bother me the way it probably should. And my scrubs have been looser, so… I guess it’s enough that it’s showing. I’m not trying to lose weight or anything.
Has there been a time when you genuinely didn’t feel any desire to eat for an entire day, even when you weren’t busy, stressed, or distracted?

I don’t know if I’d say a whole entire day where I had zero desire… maybe that’s a little strong. But yeah, there have been days where eating just felt really unappealing, and I basically got by on coffee and maybe a granola bar before work.

It’s not intentional or anything—I’m not trying to lose weight—but my scrubs have been hanging looser, so I guess it’s been more than just a skipped meal here and there. Does that answer what you’re asking?
Have there been multiple days when you genuinely didn’t feel any desire to eat at all, even when you weren’t busy, stressed, or distracted?

Yeah… multiple days, I think that’s fair to say. I don’t want to make it sound like I’m refusing food or anything, because it’s not like that. It’s more like food just doesn’t feel worth the effort or doesn’t appeal to me, even when I’m not especially busy.

Some days before a shift I’ll realize I’ve basically only had coffee and maybe a granola bar, and I just keep going. And my scrubs have been hanging loose, so… I guess it’s noticeable. I’m not trying to lose weight, though.
Has there been a time recently when you genuinely didn’t feel any urge to eat, even when you knew you should, like in the morning when you wake up or during regular meal times?

Yeah… recently, yes. I don’t know if I’d say it’s every morning or anything, but there are times I wake up and know I should eat before work, and I just… don’t really feel any urge to.

I’ll end up having coffee, maybe forcing down a granola bar before a shift, and that’s kind of it for a while. It feels embarrassing to say, because I know better, working in healthcare and all. And my scrubs have been hanging looser, so I guess it’s not just in my head. I’m not trying to lose weight, though.
Has your lack of interest in eating or feeling like you don’t want to eat been occurring almost every day, even when you’re not worried about anything or feeling down?

Almost every day… yeah, I think so. I don’t want to overstate it, but it’s been happening a lot, even when I’m not especially worried or upset.

Some days I’ll go into a shift having only had coffee and maybe a granola bar, and that’s about all I can get down. It’s not like I’m trying to lose weight or anything, but my scrubs have been hanging looser, so I guess it’s been enough to notice. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Has there been a period of time lasting at least two weeks when you felt little to no desire to eat almost every day, even when you weren’t feeling particularly down or stressed?

Yeah… I think there has been at least a couple weeks where it was like that most days. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but my eating has gotten pretty off.

Some mornings before a shift I’ll basically just have coffee and maybe a granola bar, and then I keep going even though I know I probably should eat more. And my scrubs have been hanging loose lately, which is… I guess a sign it’s not nothing. I’m not trying to lose weight or anything. Does that answer what you’re asking?
